g.text: Partial noise + anchor modes: complete simultaneous loss and lagged opportunity populations
D = eA - eB; M = (eA + eB)/2; R = M - kD. Coefficients use the pinned covariance, with a separate zero-contrast branch.
Lagged D subtracts known truth motion and is an offline oracle diagnostic. Missing projections are blank; pooled values use matched pairs.
Model excludes drift/transport and is not calibrated. Inputs and phases overlap; recorded control and held goals remain fixed.
